items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: I was friends with him as long as he lived.

ctx.x: Well, we left out Tony Giardina, who was back before the band.

Oh boy, Tony Giardina. You're going back to 19 when your brother... You know when I quit that band? My old brother, I was trying to teach him trumpet when he was only about 14. He went to sleep on the bandstand. So Tony Giardina says, you're going to get that kid off the bandstand. I said, the kid don't, of course I was drinking them days. I said, the kid don't sleep there, I don't play. That was the end of my job. And my brother-in-law says, you were tough in them days. He's tough now. He's a big rascal. But he…
Well, I liked his playing, huh?
